_readme: Plan for 30 topics. Each entry gives metadata, ONE grammar focus, a story idea, and 20 core English words. Claude Code must expand each entry into a full topic JSON (same structure as supermarket.json): Arabic meanings, IPA phonetics, an example sentence per word, 10 sentences, a story with Arabic translation, a grammar section, and 8 exercises. The array is ordered as a learning path (easy to harder).

topics.title: Meeting People
topics.description: Introduce yourself, greet people, and make small talk.
topics.grammarFocus: Verb to be (am / is / are) in statements and questions
topics.storyIdea: Sam meets a new colleague on his first day and they introduce themselves.

topics.title: Daily Routine
topics.description: Talk about what you do every day, from waking up to going to sleep.
topics.grammarFocus: Present simple (I wake up / he wakes up) and adverbs of frequency
topics.storyIdea: A day in the life of a busy programmer who loves coffee and hates Mondays.

topics.title: Family & Home
topics.description: Describe your family, your house, and the rooms in it.
topics.grammarFocus: There is / There are and prepositions of place (in, on, under, next to)
topics.storyIdea: A man describes his new house and family to a friend over the phone.

topics.title: Coffee Shop
topics.description: Order drinks and snacks politely and pay the bill.
topics.grammarFocus: Would like / Can I have ... ? for polite requests
topics.storyIdea: A shy customer tries to order a complicated coffee and the barista helps.

topics.title: Restaurant
topics.description: Book a table, order a meal, and ask for the bill.
topics.grammarFocus: Countable and uncountable nouns with some / any
topics.storyIdea: A family celebrates a birthday at a restaurant and the waiter forgets one dish.

topics.title: Clothes Shopping
topics.description: Ask for sizes, try things on, and talk about prices.
topics.grammarFocus: How much / How many, this / that / these / those
topics.storyIdea: A man looks for a jacket for a wedding and finds the perfect size on sale.

topics.title: School
topics.description: Talk about classes, teachers, homework, and exams.
topics.grammarFocus: Imperatives and can / can't for permission and ability
topics.storyIdea: A student forgets his homework and has to explain to the teacher.

topics.title: Weather
topics.description: Describe the weather and make plans around it.
topics.grammarFocus: Present continuous (it is raining) vs present simple (it rains a lot)
topics.storyIdea: Two friends plan a picnic but the weather keeps changing.

topics.title: Asking for Directions
topics.description: Ask for and give directions in a city.
topics.grammarFocus: Imperatives for directions and prepositions of movement
topics.storyIdea: A tourist gets lost looking for the train station and a kind local helps.

topics.title: Taxi & Ride Apps
topics.description: Book a ride, give your destination, and pay the driver.
topics.grammarFocus: Can / Could for requests and Wh- questions
topics.storyIdea: A traveler takes a taxi to the airport in heavy traffic and worries about time.

topics.title: Gym & Sports
topics.description: Talk about exercise, sports, and staying healthy.
topics.grammarFocus: Comparatives and superlatives (faster, the strongest)
topics.storyIdea: A beginner joins a gym and compares himself to his stronger friend.

topics.title: Pharmacy
topics.description: Describe symptoms and ask for medicine safely.
topics.grammarFocus: Should / shouldn't for advice
topics.storyIdea: A man with a bad cold asks the pharmacist what to take.

topics.title: Hospital
topics.description: Describe how you feel, see a doctor, and understand instructions.
topics.grammarFocus: Have got / have + symptoms, and questions with How long ...?
topics.storyIdea: A woman goes to the emergency room with a high fever and talks to the doctor.

topics.title: Dentist
topics.description: Explain tooth problems and understand treatment.
topics.grammarFocus: Past simple (regular and irregular verbs)
topics.storyIdea: A man avoids the dentist for two years, then finally goes after a toothache.

topics.title: Vacation
topics.description: Plan a trip, talk about places, and share holiday stories.
topics.grammarFocus: Going to for plans and past simple for holiday stories
topics.storyIdea: A family plans and then enjoys a beach holiday, with one funny mishap.

topics.title: Hotel
topics.description: Book a room, check in, and solve problems during your stay.
topics.grammarFocus: Present continuous for arrangements and polite complaints
topics.storyIdea: A guest checks in late and finds the air conditioner broken.

topics.title: Airport
topics.description: Check in, pass security, and board your flight.
topics.grammarFocus: Must / have to / don't have to for rules
topics.storyIdea: A traveler rushes through security and almost misses his boarding call.

topics.title: Public Transport
topics.description: Use buses, trains, and metro, and ask about schedules.
topics.grammarFocus: Prepositions of time and transport (at 8, by bus, on the train)
topics.storyIdea: A new city resident learns the metro system and takes the wrong line once.

topics.title: Cooking at Home
topics.description: Follow a recipe and talk about ingredients and steps.
topics.grammarFocus: Sequence words and imperatives for recipes (first, then, after that)
topics.storyIdea: A beginner cooks dinner for his friends following a recipe and nearly burns the rice.

topics.title: Barber & Salon
topics.description: Explain what you want and describe your appearance.
topics.grammarFocus: Have something done (I want to have my hair cut) and adjectives of appearance
topics.storyIdea: A man asks for a small trim and the barber cuts it way too short.

topics.title: Party & Celebrations
topics.description: Invite people, accept or decline, and enjoy celebrations.
topics.grammarFocus: Will / won't for offers and spontaneous decisions
topics.storyIdea: Friends plan a surprise birthday party, but the guest of honor arrives early.

topics.title: Movies & Entertainment
topics.description: Talk about films, series, and what you like to watch.
topics.grammarFocus: Like / love / hate + -ing and giving opinions
topics.storyIdea: Two friends argue about which movie to watch and compromise at the cinema.

topics.title: Bank
topics.description: Open an account, transfer money, and solve card problems.
topics.grammarFocus: Present perfect (I have lost my card / Have you ever ...?)
topics.storyIdea: A customer loses his bank card abroad and calls the bank for help.

topics.title: Phone & Internet
topics.description: Solve phone and internet problems and talk to customer support.
topics.grammarFocus: Present perfect vs past simple (It has stopped working / It stopped yesterday)
topics.storyIdea: A man calls customer support because his internet has been down for two days.

topics.title: Online Shopping
topics.description: Order online, track a delivery, and return items.
topics.grammarFocus: Passive voice (The package was delivered / will be shipped)
topics.storyIdea: A customer receives the wrong item and goes through the return process.

topics.title: Office Work
topics.description: Handle meetings, emails, deadlines, and teamwork.
topics.grammarFocus: First conditional (If we finish early, we will ...) and workplace requests
topics.storyIdea: A team races to meet a deadline and a surprise meeting changes everything.

topics.title: A Developer's Day
topics.description: English for stand-ups, code reviews, bugs, and deployments.
topics.grammarFocus: Present perfect continuous and giving status updates (I've been working on ...)
topics.storyIdea: A developer fixes a critical bug before release and explains it in the stand-up.

topics.title: Job Interview
topics.description: Answer common interview questions with confidence.
topics.grammarFocus: Second conditional (If I got the job, I would ...) and talking about experience
topics.storyIdea: A candidate prepares for his dream job interview and answers a tough question.

topics.title: Renting an Apartment
topics.description: Talk to landlords, ask about rent, and understand contracts.
topics.grammarFocus: Used to / would, and relative clauses (the flat that I saw)
topics.storyIdea: A young man searches for his first apartment and negotiates with the landlord.

topics.title: Emergencies & Police
topics.description: Report problems and ask for urgent help calmly.
topics.grammarFocus: Past continuous vs past simple (I was walking when I saw ...)
topics.storyIdea: A man's bag is stolen and he reports it to the police step by step.
